description:
• Brand introduction:The origin of the KOSHINÉ is rooted in a great discovery by a team of scientists exploring the mysteries of life. The scientific team of KOSHINÉ has long been dedicated to researching cancer drugs in the hope of bringing a gospel of life extension to humanity. Over the course of more than a decade of dedicated exploration, they discovered a unique compound, 826, which exhibited remarkable effects when applied topically, especially when it acted on androgens, demonstrating extraordinary efficacy.

For a long time, androgens have been influencing human hair growth, and hair loss has been one of the major concerns for humans. After 15 years of research, the KOSHINÉ scientific team has gradually uncovered the interaction mechanism between compound 826 and androgen receptors.

Life's value is not just in its duration but in its quality. Although life may be brief, it can shine with remarkable vitality. From our initial aspiration to extend life to our current commitment to enhancing life's beauty, the KOSHINÉ brand emerges as a symbol of this journey.
• Product description:The core patent component of KOSHINÉ 826,which is 826,demonstrated excellent safety and efficacy in clinical trials.It can effectively improve the issue of "oil hair,hair loss and baldness".Consistent use of this product cancan regulate the hair follicle growth cycle, promote healthy hair growth, strengthen the hair roots, and achieve plump and thick hair.
• USP (Unique Selling Point):Ideal for Those Seeking Oil Control, Hair Loss Prevention, and New Hair Growth

Refreshingly Oil Control
KOSHINÉ 826 addresses the sebaceous hyperplasia and excessive oil production commonly associated with androgenetic alopecia. Notice a significant reduction in oiliness within just 3 days.

Root-Cause Hair Loss Prevention
The core ingredient, 826, competes with dihydrotestosterone (DHT) for androgen receptor binding, inhibiting its impact. This restores the health of hair follicle cells, promoting healthier hair growth.

Visible New Hair Growth
Experience new hair growth within 4-6 weeks. KOSHINÉ 826 encourages the growth of healthy, robust hair rather than just soft vellus hair.
• Payment terms:PayPal and shopify payments
• Other information:Experimental data,pre-use,use for 6 weeks,use for 12 weeks,use for 24 weeks

According to the company's clinical trial reports, 826 demonstrated favorable effectiveness and safety.Compared to baseline, the number of non-cuirass hairs (TAHC) in the target area of the 0.5% BID (twice daily) trial group increases 22.73 hair/cm^2 on average after 24th weeks of treatment. Some trial users saw hair growth effects as early as week6.

*Data source: Phase II clinical study report of KX0826-CN-1002 experimental group
